name: Finding Your Wife
overview: Scripture reveals that finding a wife is a significant blessing and an act that brings favor from the LORD, as a prudent and virtuous wife is a valuable gift far above material wealth. A godly wife is described as a crown to her husband, bringing honor and joy, while marriage itself is to be honored and kept undefiled. These verses emphasize the divine origin and importance of a godly wife in the life of a believer, underscoring the sacredness of marriage and the high value of a woman of virtue.
